description:

description:
S01 E03
An 18-year-old claims she doesn't remember stabbing her foster mother to death; a Los Angeles mechanic is questioned about the serial murders of local sex workers; an Oklahoma state senator is involved in sex trafficking of minors.

title: Interrogation Files
description:
S01 E04
An army soldier is questioned about the shooting death of his teenage girlfriend; detectives interrogate a Brazilian expatriate about her husband's murder; a woman is questioned about the death of her 17-month-old daughter.

title: Interrogation Cam
description:
S01 E14
Investigators interrogate a prison inmate about an unsolved serial killer case from the '90s; a former police sergeant is questioned about the murder of his mistress; a detective questions a woman suspected of running someone over with her car.

title: Interrogation Cam
description:

description:

description:

description:
